title: React Native
description: Native mobile components with shared tokens and behaviour.
setup: Use minerva-design/native in React Native or Expo. Keep the React version required by your Expo SDK. No web stylesheet is needed; MinervaProvider resolves tokens to native styles. The workspace includes apps/expo-example.
validation: React Native Testing Library and react-native-web tests cover component interactions. Expo Go 57.0.9 was exercised on an iPhone 17 Pro / iOS 26.1 simulator and a Pixel 8 / Android 16 API 36 ARM64 emulator. Verified flows include text entry, table sorting/selection, autocomplete, menus, lossless JSON formatting, document preview and a 10,000-row virtual list. Android additionally verified system file selection/removal and clipboard copy/paste. Physical devices and standalone release installation remain unverified.
